_about: OFF-2 · every table an outbox action (OFF-5 §2, QUEUED) writes, and what makes a repeated send leave ONE row. kind 'key' = (owner, idempotency_key) UNIQUE, owned by OFF-2; 'natural' = the pair IS the fact, a repeat is the same row; 'update-only' = the action is an UPDATE to a fixed value. scripts/db-off2-idempotency-check.mjs checks the 'key' entries in git; supabase/migrations/PROBE_off2_idempotency.sql checks every entry live.
